caption: The drawing shows a statue of a man standing on a rectangular pedestal. The man is dressed in formal attire, including a fitted jacket, trousers, and a top hat. His jacket is buttoned, and he has a white shirt and high collar visible at the neck and wrists. The man's right hand is bent at the elbow with the index finger pointing up, while his left hand is resting in his pants pocket. He is wearing brown shoes. The statue appears to be made of a dark, metallic material, while the pedestal has a stone-like texture with various shades of gray and some brownish stains on the front surface. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or features. The drawing uses primarily shades of black, gray, white, and brown.
title: Cigar Store Man
